CustomField.description: Versioned JSON ledger of per-recipient push and email delivery state, used when the notification's Contact has no active User and delivery must fan out to every approved support relationship helper. Written and read only by FimbySupportedIdentityDelivery. Push_Status__c and Email_Status__c remain the aggregate channel statuses the batch jobs query on. Never rendered on an Experience Cloud surface.
CustomField.label: Delivery State
